description:
The Club Racer is the Swiss army knife of the IndyFab line up. Loaded up or stripped down, it offers versatile performance! This frameset incorporates traditional road bike geometry paired with all of the options for light touring. It is designed with longer chainstays and taller fork to accommodate fenders and slightly larger tires. The Club Racer makes an excellent commuter bike, rainy day trainer, or light-touring rig.

Designed for light touring, commuting, gravel roads, club rides, and more

components.description: Size specific tubing to ensure uniform ride in any size
Head tube and down tube gusset for optimal strength and stiffness
All tubes are sealed except the seat tube to minimize corrosion (Read about seat tube and frame maintenance)
